dedupe_keys.name: ethos builda residential building tabula archetype dataset germany

description: This dataset lists all residential buildings in Germany with their construction year, size class, refurbishment state and TABULA archetype, as a partial dump (version v8_20240916) of ETHOS.BUILDA, a building-level database of the German stock developed at Forschungszentrum Jülich. ETHOS.BUILDA combines various data sources and fills gaps with machine learning to produce one consistent, complete building dataset; each attribute carries its value, its source and a lineage code for the assignment method, with lookup tables of sources and lineages. Building data are split by federal state (NUTS-1 files, several hundred MB to over 1 GB each) and each building has an identifier and a centroid in EPSG:3035. The method is described by Dabrock, Ulken, Pflugradt, Weinand and Stolten in 'Generating a nationwide residential building types dataset using machine learning' (Building and Environment 2025; SSRN preprint 2024). Coverage: residential buildings in Germany. Access: free Zenodo download (version 2.0.0, October 2024) and an HTTP API with a Python client. Licence: Open Database License, with contents under their source licences. Caveats: many attributes are model predictions, not observations, and non-residential buildings are not in this dump. Simulation uses: national and local heat demand and retrofit models using TABULA archetypes. Related records: TABULA/EPISCOPE typologies and the Germany building types map.
